svg.title: C18-M03-F3: Defence layers
svg.desc: A pipeline of defences before the model (filters, retrieval scope, delimiting) and after it (tool policy, output filter, safe rendering), with logging throughout.
svg.text: input filter -> retrieval scope + sanitise -> prompt delimiting -> MODEL
-> tool policy (code) -> output filter -> UI (text, allowlisted links)
-> logs and alerts at every layer
Figure C18-M03-F3. Layers before and after the model.
